_README: Copy this file to <campaign-slug>.json (e.g. jolly-for-governor.json), fill in the real values, and run `node scripts/provision-customer.js customers/<filename>`. Re-running with the same name updates an existing customer in place. CRITICAL: do NOT add bare-token aliases (single first or last names like 'Jolly' or 'Cinde'). The matcher is permissive by design — bare tokens trip on unrelated content (e.g., 'Jolly Sailors', 'Joe Warmington' for a different person same surname, Spanish 'Cristóbal' matching 'Crist'). Aliases should be either multi-token variants or unique full nicknames. Empty aliases array is preferred — search_terms drive ingest queries.
name: Campaign Display Name
